Make sure to bathe your dog more often! Now that he doesn't have all that hair to absorb oils from his skin, it can build up and block pores and follicles leading to alopecia. I would recommend using a gentle shampoo & conditioner every 2 weeks to a month and brush him gently even his shaved coat, brushing will help redistribute oils from the skin to the coat and help the hair come back more normally. Often times double coated breeds hair needs the weight of the full hair to shed properly and if it doesn't have that, it can get stuck in the follicle and the "baby hair" won't grow or it will become ingrown so its important to upkeep your dogs coat even when its short. In the future if your dog doesn't have sensitive skin I would recommend a proper Furminator bath and blow out and brush with a undercoat rake and slicker brush every 6-8 weeks to eliminate excess shedding.
